1_byte_identity_every_other_arm._why_prove_what_holds_by_construction: The third EWMA class adds a dict key no existing arm reads and every new switch defaults OFF, so identity should hold BY CONSTRUCTION. It is proved anyway: 'no existing arm reads it' is exactly the kind of claim that has been wrong three times on this project today.

If any fails, the CHECK IS BROKEN AND NOT THE ARM and this proof's verdict is void.
